title: betterDeconstruction
author: itsYiyas
description: Increases returns from deconstruction to 60% from 20%

title: Better Quantity Selection Screen
author: KrrKs & Kahmu
description:
Adds three additional up/down Buttons for altering the bartered quantity at orders of magnitute higher than one.
Also increases the font size of the quantitiy number.

title: Cheap Respec
author: watafuzz
description: Respeccing Ryder or the squad will now always cost 20 credits.

title: Dynamic Compass
author: Drakenreiter
description:
The compass is hidden by default and is now displayed only in the following situations:
- Omni-Tool scanner is brought up
- Weapon is drawn
- Entering the Nomad

title: Enhanced Statistics Page
author: Kahmu
description: This mod adds additional stats to the Statistics page, giving a summary of all your bonuses.

title: FA - Drack and Kesh Conversation Changes
author: KrrKs
description:
Changes the Conversations between Drack and Kesh in her office:
-Dracks line about being worried only plays once per game.
-Dialog about Vorn, the Drack meetups in Kadara Port or the 'Firebreathing Threshermaws of Doom' game should each play once reliably.
-Dracks now defaults to one of his greetings if there is nothing new.

There is another conversation about Dutch questioning Dracks merc stories that i could not trigger, but that is probably because it depends on a Conversation at the Vortex bar that never played for me.

title: Faster Quest Tracker Hiding - 5 Seconds
author: Kahmu
description:
The Quest Tracker in the top right corner disappears after 5s instead of 25s.
Decrease fade-out time from 2s to 1s.

title: FixesAddendum
author: KrrKs
description:
Fixes several Bugs and annoyances in the game that are not touched by other dedicated bugfix mods.

Note: "Squad Changes" and "Power Overhaul" MUST override this mod to work correctly!

Includes the following changes:
-Fixed Cora's offensive5 soldier anti-armour bonus being always applied, even when the skill is not taken.
-Fixed Drack's Rage anti-armour bonus not being applied when his offensive5 veteran skill is not taken.
-Fixed Cryo and Incediary ammo not receiving the appropriate bonus provided by their boosting weapon augments.
-Fixed incorrectly displayed SavingBarrier Health Threshold for Ryder and MP Chars
-Also fixed saving barrier not taking the actual set value into account, but a default value.
-Fixed Team Support skill 6a Defense Grid. This was bugged in multiple ways
-Fixed Plasma Charge Augment on Remnant weapons not going into overheat mode.
-Prevent that second door in the Eos Vault from locking in front of Ryder, when loading a save.
-Replaced angaran shuttle in Zheng He system (Nexus), orbiting H-599, with initiative model
-Replaced milkyway satellite in Civki system, orbiting H-065 with kett satellite
-Replaced angaran shuttle in Jiraider system found during 'Life on the Frontier' with initiative model
-Replaced area trigger for Bane Massani's initial conversation during Kett's Bane with character spawn trigger that is also used for the other two conversation variants (i.e., use to interact).
-Replaced the area trigger for removing kett corpses in the bunker near Bane with his dialog end trigger.
-Replaced two enemy spawns in eos kett generator-base for Kett's Bane quest, so enemies do not spawn unreachable behind walls.
-Add trigger to set three non completeable remnant locations on Eos to completed when walking near the location-marker.
-Disabled the POI for starting Liam's loyalty mission directly after it has been completed.
-Moved 5 of 9 spawnpoints in the most north eastern location remnant site on Eos ( at 'Presson Dunes' ) from underground or within the structure to the surface.
-Moved an underground spawn at the remnant site near Voeld's monolith 3 ( where the Heskaarl challenge takes place) to the surface. Also rotated it upright.
-Marked the 'Structure' on Kadara on Draullir that is used as Roekaar hideout during 'A People Divided' as completed after the quest.
-Added additional stilt parts to one of the buildings in the Elaaden initiative outpost, that was floating in the air.
-Moved several screens and terminals at the nexus so they don't float in the air
-Fixed placed remnant cover that only exists while scanning to be always physical
-Removed Scourge from Hyperion Cryobay after the prologue, light up the closes tendril during prologue.

title: Increased Outlaws Spawns
author: Kahmu
description:
Increases the number of enemies in Outlaw groups, including the Outcasts, the Collective and the Roekaar.
Also increases the number of harder enemies (e.g. Pariah) per group.

title: Increased Research Data Point Income
author: Taamro
description: Increases all incoming Research Data from scannable objects and space anomalies. Base incoming RD is doubled and 2 Cryo Pod Perks provides additional +25% bonus each.

title: MEA Fixpack
author: NightWolf2503
description:
Fixes various issues in Mass Effect: Andromeda left unresolved by the developers.


New in version 1.05d:

- Re-exported the mod once again to fix some bugs

Conversations and Cutscenes:

- More fixes to the scene that plays when trying a leaf of the plant during "Task: Running a Fever"


New in version 1.05c:

- Re-exorted the mod with Frosty 1.0.4.5.


New in version 1.05b:

Skills and Profiles:

- Fixed Life Support and Shield Feedback not activating when using Assault Turret and Flamethrower unless other tech powers are equipped.


New in version 1.05a:

Changes/corrections to existing fixes:

- Holding down the power button to grab enemies with pull won't cause them to drop to the ground anymore.


New in version 1.05:

Actors:

- Fixed one of Annea's mercs running through the room during the cutscene that starts after scanning the artifact in the lake, during the quest "Water Supply".
- The water merchant at the paradise, on Elaaden, will only appear if Annea is still in charge.
- Stopped Astra from following the player when loading a save or returning to the area, during the quest "Brought to Light".

Codex and Journal:

- Fixed permanent unread mark on the journal caused by the quest "Cora Harper: A Foundation".

Conversations and Cutscenes:

- Stopped conversation with Jun-Seo Park, the teacher at Prodromos, from repeating.
- Stopped the reconstructed conversation in Resilience, on Eos, from repeating every time the room is scanned.
- Prevented dialogue about the kett, during "Jaal Ama Darav: Friend or Foe?", from being played twice.
- Fixed Sid's dialogue being unavailable after starting the quest "Life on the Frontier".
- Stopped the conversation about the temperature decrease on Elaaden from repeating every time you return to the paradise after activating the vault.
- Squadmates won't comment on the water tanks at the paradise, on Elaaden, if the source of the water has already been found.
- Stopped Ryder's comments about false signals from the quest "Cora Harper: Asari Ark" after the transponder has been found.
- Stopped conversation between Addison and Spender from repeating every time you go near her.
- Fixed people on the nexus acting as if the angaran delegation was already there if you go there after rescuing the Moshae but before visiting Aya.
- Fixed dialogue being played when approaching the kett base on Voeld.
- Stopped the dialogue being played when approaching the datapad from the quest "Task: Cold Hard Cache" from repeating
- Fixed dialogue from "Something in the Water" playing when entering Charibdys Point on Kadara after the quest was completed.
- Fixed Ryder's head getting tilted when listening to the datapad on a platform of the watchtower in front of the cave entrance at Draullir (the cave where the Collective's base is).
- Changed camera angles in the conversation with Annea, during the quest "Water Supply" so the view isn't obstructed by Ryder's shoulder.
- Stopped dialogue being played when approaching Erosek, on Voeld, from repeating.

Crafting:

- Changed platinum requirement for the tier 3 pathfinder chest piece from 10 to 20, so the progression is now 20>20>20>30>30>30>30>40>40>40 instead of 20>20>10>30>30>30>30>40>40>40.

Quests:

- Task: Earn Your Badge; killing the remnant destroyer too fast will no longer prevent the last few remnant from spawning.
- Brought to Light; loading a save at the stage "Speak to Astra", after defeating the first wave of kett, will no longer cause the quest to get stuck.
- Task: Roekaar Manifestos; fixed an issue where data pads could show up as duplicates, making it impossible to complete the quest. (Does not work retroactively)

Skills and Profiles:

- Fixed a bug in Pull that could prevent enemies it was used on to be targeted by Charge and Avenger Strike.

title: Nomad ND2 One-Click Mining Doubled Minerals
author: Eddga
description:
This version of the enhanced Nomad ND2 features:
- top speed increase
- increased boost capacity
- useful hover thrust (as the implemented vanilla thrust was pretty useless in my opinion)
- one-click mining (only one drone per area needed)
- 2x minerals from mining

Credits go to:
watafuzz's Road Rage mod https://www.nexusmods.com/masseffectandromeda/mods/254 - Thanks for uploading your project file! Couldn't have made this without it!
fuxsart' Fast Mining mod https://www.nexusmods.com/masseffectandromeda/mods/761 - Thanks for the idea! (project-file unfortunately was missing so I did this from scratch)

title: Researchable Halberd
author: KrrKs
description:
Makes the Halberd Research Projects available.
Also increases the number of augmentation slots from 2 to 3
(From 3 to 4 with the respective cryo pod perk)

title: Tempest Superstore Rank 01
author: Kjaro
description:
Important:  This mod requires a little bit of cooperation from your side, given that I had to build a different version for each rank.  That means every time you unlock a new weapon rank you'll have to switch to the corresponding version in the Mod Manager.  Since this only happens every 10 level ups, I believe it to be a minor inconvenience.

The Tempest kiosk now stocks
- 1,000 pcs of each material
- 100 pcs of each consumable
- 50 pcs of each uncommon augmentation
- 5 pcs of each rare and ultra rare augmentation
- 5 pcs of each mod slot augmentation
- 5 pcs of each fire type augmentation
- 5 Remnant decryption keys
- 1 piece of each weapon mod
- every Nomad paint job
- every Nomad upgrade

In case you feel like this still isn't enough: simply save and reload to restock.

title: Weapon Overhaul
author: Kahmu
description:
This mod rebalances all weapons, so all are actually useful.
Some of the weaker weapons (e.g. Charger) were significantly buffed, while some overpowered weapons (e.g. Dhan) have been nerfed.

Some weapon have adjusted Magazine Size/Fire Rate/etc. to give each weapon a unique identiy.

Weapon Weight is no longer reduced by higher ranks, so a rank X Carnifex has the same weight as a rank I Carnifex.
In the Vanilla game, Weapon Weight is pretty irrelevant on higher levels, especially because you only have to invest a few skill points to get extra weight capacity.
Increases the base Weight Capacity from 30 to 35.
